title: import: verify `sys_import_job` serves `sys_exchange_rate` (CSV of currency, rate, effective_date); add the importer only if it does not (multi-currency M1-2, epic #8345)
body:
Blocked-by: #27185

Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). Ruling 6465431966 on #27119 (batch #421 item 2, Q1 = 乙-现在, maintainer 「同意立专题卡」 2026-10-28): the multi-currency epic resumes on #8345 in shape C′. Part of #8345. Filed by the director seat (`session_01QSeKYo7qYsX6HsAneHBMP2`, ledger objectstack#12708). ⛔ Not a claim. Workload row and precedents: 6464936321; design: 6464438764.

Ruling-ref: 6465431966

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 验证现有的按对象导入通道（`POST /data/:object/import/jobs`）能导汇率表；能则只补一行文档，不能则补一个 CSV 导入器。
- **为什么改：** 财务一年 12 行 × N 币种，一次导完。
- **风险与回滚：** 零或 S。
- **先看：** `packages/platform-objects/src/audit/sys-import-job.object.ts`、导入服务。
- **两分钟验证：** 导入一份 CSV 后列表页出现各行、重复 (currency, date) 被拒。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## Task

- [ ] Measure first; report the reading on the card before any code.
- [ ] If needed: the importer; else the docs line.

Lane: server · Size: XS–S · Review: default. `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Epic: #8345 (parent; the epic PM dispatches `pm:epic` children; `domain:spec` children go to the spec seat's queue). Dedupe: #8345 thread, #27119 (ruled), the workload list 6464936321; no open card carries this slice.
